sentences.text: No: on 2025-10-15, the documents say a UCB may, at its option, offer EMI-based personal loan borrowers a choice to switch to a fixed rate at the time of reset, so it is not required.

The RBI circular applies to Primary (Urban) Co-operative Banks, and Example UCB’s policy uses the same discretionary wording: “may, at its option, offer the borrower a choice to switch to a fixed rate.”
